name: Capital Markets

mofsl_2qfy27.headline: Capital market players witness a decline in volumes; AUM continues to grow
mofsl_2qfy27.read: Cash ADTO, futures ADTO and options premium ADTO fell 12%, 19% and 19% QoQ in 2QFY27, weighing on Angel One and Groww, while monthly demat additions rose to ~3m in Aug'26 and MTF books expanded. AMC industry SIP inflows held at ~INR320b a month, yields improved marginally QoQ (SBI FM and Nippon yields slipped slightly), and treasury income moderated; aggregate sector revenue reached INR147.8b and PAT INR66.6b. Wealth (360 ONE) and RTAs (KFin, CAMS) did well; BSE had a weaker F&O quarter but better IPO activity, and MCX missed despite commodity volume highs.

unit_economics: Brokers: net revenue = orders x revenue per order + MTF spread + float + DP fees - AP payouts and finance cost, with EBDAT margin after employee and marketing cost; AMCs: revenue = average AUM x yield (bp), core profit = revenue - fixed opex, treasury income shown apart.

price_drivers.driver: F&O premium turnover and SEBI/STT regulation
price_drivers.why: Retail options orders are the largest profit pool for discount brokers; Q2FY27 options premium ADTO fell 19% QoQ and STT rose from 1-Apr-2026.

price_drivers.driver: Equity AUM, SIP flows and equity net-flow share
price_drivers.why: AMC revenue tracks average equity AUM; SIP inflows of ~INR320b a month give a base while market falls cut AUM and yield mix.
Groww guides MTF book growth of INR6-7b a quarter; MTF spread and ECL are the recurring, rate-sensitive profit line in brokers.
BER cuts, telescopic slab crossing and passive mix move yield by 1-4bp, which is 3-8% of revenue at a 40bp yield; SIF and alternates yields (90-95bp at IPRUAMC) add a higher-margin layer.

price_drivers.driver: IPO and exchange activity, commodity volumes
price_drivers.why: BSE and MCX earnings follow F&O and commodity turnover; BSE has a pipeline of 100+ mainboard listings targeting ~INR1.5t.

kpis.name: F&O premium ADTO (industry) and company share
kpis.definition: Average daily options premium turnover plus futures notional turnover on NSE and BSE, with each broker's share of retail turnover and of NSE active clients.
kpis.formula: Options premium ADTO + futures notional ADTO; company share = company ADTO / industry ADTO
kpis.why_it_moves_price: F&O is the dominant share of discount-broker net revenue; MOFSL reports futures ADTO -19% and options premium ADTO -19% QoQ in 2QFY27, and broker earnings move more than proportionately because costs are mostly fixed.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'ADTO' or 'market share' (Angel One, Groww, Nuvama, MOFSL, IIFL Capital); Motilal Oswal results tables and monthly update notes in the report library; exchange data outside Airavat.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field for turnover; use broker models (Motilal Oswal, Kotak, Nuvama) and management commentary on regulation from transcripts. get_consensus_estimates gives PAT/EPS only.
kpis.traps: Options notional vs premium (notional is meaningless for revenue); futures-notional-plus-options-premium share basis vs retail-only share; trading days count.

kpis.name: EBDAT margin on net revenue
kpis.definition: Earnings before depreciation, amortisation and tax over net revenue (revenue less finance cost and fees and commission expense), reported and ex sponsorship and one-offs.
kpis.formula: (Net revenue - employee cost - other expenses - impairment + other income) / net revenue
kpis.why_it_moves_price: ANGELONE guides standalone margins of ~45% and consolidated 42-45% for FY27 on flat employee cost near INR11b; margin sustainability against falling volumes is what the market capitalises.
kpis.history_source: get_financials for revenue, finance cost, employee cost; get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'EBDAT' or 'cost to income'; Motilal Oswal results tables.
kpis.estimate_source: Management margin guidance from transcripts (Angel One 42-45%, Groww cost commentary); broker models. No consensus field for margin; consensus PAT/EPS embeds it.
kpis.traps: Exchange charges gross vs net in revenue; sponsorship seasonality (compare YoY); ESOP charges; float and treasury gains inside other income.

kpis.name: AMC revenue yield (bp of QAAUM, day-adjusted)
kpis.definition: Revenue from operations (ex fair-value gains) over quarterly average AUM, annualised by days in the quarter, shown for MF, passive and alternates separately.
kpis.formula: Core revenue x 365 / days in quarter / QAAUM
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Revenue yield times AUM is revenue; a 1bp change on a ~40bp yield is 2.5% of revenue. MOFSL records yields improving marginally QoQ across the industry while SBI FM and Nippon contracted slightly.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'yield' or 'QAAUM' (HDFC AMC, Nippon, ICICI Pru AMC, SBI Funds, UTI, ABSL AMC, Canara Robeco); get_financials for revenue; Motilal Oswal results tables.
kpis.estimate_source: Company yield commentary and guidance from transcripts (IPRUAMC alternates net yield 90-95bp); broker models; no yield consensus. get_consensus_estimates gives PAT/EPS.
kpis.traps: Denominator scope (MF only vs incl. alternates), x4 vs day-count annualisation, fair-value gains booked in revenue, P&L-neutral mandates, one-offs such as fee reversals under regulatory settlements.

kpis.name: Equity AUM, SIP flows and ex-arbitrage net-flow share
kpis.definition: Average and closing equity AUM, SIP contributions (ex-STP), and the AMC's share of industry equity net flows excluding arbitrage funds.
kpis.formula: Company equity net flows ex-arbitrage / industry equity net flows ex-arbitrage; AUM split into flows and market movement
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Flow share below AUM share predicts share loss; SBIFM expects 50-60% of tech spend growth to be productivity and HDFCAMC plans two SIFs, so franchise momentum and flows set the AUM growth premium.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'net flows', 'SIP' and 'market share'; Motilal Oswal results tables; AMFI data outside Airavat for industry totals.
kpis.estimate_source: Broker AUM models (Motilal Oswal, Nuvama, Kotak) and management flow commentary from transcripts; no consensus for AUM; consensus gives PAT/EPS.
kpis.traps: SIP including STP overstates new money; gold and silver ETF market movement follows metal prices not equity indices; acquired AUM in alternates; three different SIP-share definitions.

kpis.name: NSE active clients and market share of incremental clients
kpis.definition: NSE active clients by broker, active ratio, and share of incremental demat accounts and active clients.
kpis.formula: Broker NSE active clients / industry NSE active clients
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Client share leads orders and revenue by 2-4 quarters; MOFSL notes monthly demat additions rose QoQ to ~3m in Aug'26.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'active clients' and 'gross additions'; monthly business updates via search_research for Angel One and Groww.
kpis.estimate_source: Broker models and management client-addition commentary from transcripts; no consensus field.
kpis.traps: Registered vs funded vs NSE-active definitions; stale accounts; cross-broker comparison needs NSE active basis.

kpis.name: MTF book, yield and spread
kpis.definition: Average margin trading facility book, yield including delayed-payment charges, funding cost on allocated borrowings and ECL.
kpis.formula: Interest on MTF / average MTF book - funding cost on allocated borrowings
kpis.why_it_moves_price: MTF is the recurring earnings leg that cushions volume falls; Groww guides book growth of INR6-7b a quarter and RBI's 2026 exposure norms raise bank funding costs.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'MTF' or 'client funding'; get_financials for interest income, finance cost and borrowings.
kpis.estimate_source: Management MTF growth guidance from transcripts (Groww INR6-7b a quarter); broker models; no consensus field.
kpis.traps: Borrowings also fund exchange margins so total finance cost overstates MTF funding; delayed-payment charges are behavioural; MTF book / net worth stretch above 2.5x.

kpis.name: Core PAT and treasury income share (AMCs and brokers)
kpis.definition: Core operating profit after tax, with fair-value gains and treasury income shown separately; for AMCs core PAT per bp of AAUM.
kpis.formula: (Fee revenue - total expenses) x (1 - tax rate on PBT before exceptionals); treasury PAT = other income x (1 - tax)
kpis.why_it_moves_price: MOFSL notes treasury and other income moderated QoQ after healthy gains; the market values AMCs and brokers on core earnings, so a treasury-led beat deserves a lower multiple.
kpis.history_source: get_financials for revenue, other income, fair-value gains; get_investor_presentation for core operating profit definitions.
kpis.estimate_source: get_consensus_estimates for PAT, EPS and P/E (Bloomberg, mixes core and treasury); broker models (Motilal Oswal) for core split.
kpis.traps: Revenue basis incl. or excl. fair-value gains; exceptional items taxed differently; mandatory skin-in-the-game investments are not surplus cash.

kpis.name: ARR yield, exchange volumes and RTA non-MF revenue
kpis.definition: Recurring revenue yield and cost-to-income at wealth managers, F&O/commodity turnover at exchanges, and non-mutual-fund revenue growth and margins at RTAs.
kpis.formula: ARR / average AUM; exchange revenue / turnover; non-MF revenue growth
kpis.why_it_moves_price: 360 ONE guides cost-to-income at 46-47% and quarterly TBR of INR2-2.25b; KFIN expects Ascent margins to reach double digits in a couple of quarters; these are the non-broker earnings pools in the group.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'ARR', 'TBR', 'cost to income' for 360 ONE and Nuvama; KFIN and CAMS decks for RTA lines; BSE, MCX and CDSL via get_financials.
kpis.estimate_source: Management guidance from transcripts (360ONE, KFIN, BSE); broker models; get_consensus_estimates for PAT/EPS.
kpis.traps: Wealth ARR vs transactional revenue; exchange revenue sensitive to regulation on weekly expiries; RTA yields move with industry AUM mix.

valuation_anchor: P/E on core earnings ex-cash for AMCs and brokers (own band split pre- and post-SEBI F&O measures; AMC market cap as % of AAUM beside the core PAT yield); P/E for exchanges, depositories and RTAs; wealth managers on P/E and market cap to AUM.
watch_next_quarter: Watch F&O premium ADTO and demat additions after the 2QFY27 decline, Groww's MTF book trajectory (INR6-7b a quarter), Angel One's margin against its 42-45% guide, HDFC AMC's two SIF launches, IPRUAMC alternates yield of 90-95bp, BSE's listing pipeline (100+ companies, ~INR1.5t) and KFIN's Ascent margin path.
